category.name: Credential phishing
category.short: Fake sign-in pages that steal passwords and sessions
category.summary: Pages that imitate a sign-in or document-sharing service to collect a username and password. Many relay the login to the real service as it happens (adversary-in-the-middle), so they also steal the session and get past most multi-factor prompts.
